title: Stabilize WebView document scroll restoration
summary: Prevent broad WebView refresh scroll-preservation code from forcing the outer document scrollbar to stale top or bottom offsets.
reason: The Tauri/WebView shell could replay document scroll positions after async rendering and deferred DOM work, which made the full-page scrollbar appear to snap unexpectedly.
behavior_before: Shared scroll restoration always restored the document scrollbar, clamped stale positions to the current maximum, and replayed the same document position across deferred frames.
behavior_after: Shared scroll restoration preserves internal scroll containers while skipping unsafe document restores after content shrink or user movement; keyboard row focus no longer scrolls the full page implicitly.
manual_validation: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ops\\scripts\\smoke\\Test-WebViewBrowserLargeTableSmoke.ps1 -> failed before test import without PYTHONPATH=src (ModuleNotFoundError: mediapipeline)
rollback_plan: Revert the dom/table.js scroll-restoration guard and the focused WebView DOM helper smoke updates.
notes:
This is frontend scroll behavior only. It does not change backend routes, settings persistence, queue mutation, media policy, publish/drain, rename, or filesystem behavior.
Guarded document-level scroll restoration against stale bottom clamps and deferred user-scroll overrides while preserving internal scroll containers.
